title: Underhalls
brief: Sewer/tech hybrid: branching underhalls, water hazards, a red door progression, and combat in overlapping vertical layers. Teaches non-linear sewer navigation and that lowering floors/water change routes.
pacing_notes: More junctiony than Entryway; soft gates via water and red key; fights use height and corners.

part_designs.elevation: drop or stairs into lower network
part_designs.detail: You leave the Entryway sun for a stacked underground graph.

part_designs.shape: lattice of mid-width halls with T-junctions
part_designs.elevation: mostly one level with occasional steps
part_designs.detail: Branching without spaghetti—junctions are readable; dead ends hold supplies or keys.

part_designs.triggers: floor lowers that open new routes
part_designs.detail: Hazard reshapes pathing; elevation change is a mechanic, not decoration.

part_designs.shape: side circuit returning to known junction
rooms visible through grates to other floors
part_designs.detail: See enemies / items through grates before you can reach them—desire lines.

part_designs.elevation: step up out of sewers feel
part_designs.detail: Progression pays off; exit is earned by the key loop, not a new maze.

design_lessons: Return to known node after key
